$comment: Theme settings (ID4, IP4): the tokens a project may set from its theme, listed under the component that reads them. Set them with applySettings or settingsCss from @design-library/core/theme, or in your theme stylesheet on :root or a template's root. Every other --c-* token stays private. Values should read tokens (var(--space-…)) or be a length; the library keeps each default.

Shared.--border-divider: Horizontal separator width across lists, tables, accordions and layout headers/footers. Set 0px for no horizontal separators; field/control outlines, focus rings and selection indicators are unchanged. Dialog and MenuButton already use space, not dividers.

PropertySection.--c-property-section-divider-width: Optional horizontal separator between sections, absent by default. Set 0px to remove one enabled by a template.

SiteLayout.--c-site-layout-reading: The reading column's width (default the reading measure, 42rem).
SiteLayout.--c-site-layout-margin: The page margin on each column: header, main and footer content share it (default space.margin-page).
SiteLayout.--c-site-layout-gap: The space between the column's bands: hero, sections, call to action (default space.stack-page).
SiteLayout.--c-site-layout-padding-block: The space above the first band and under the last (default space.stack-page).
SiteLayout.--c-site-layout-padding-start: The space above the first band only; follows padding-block when not set. 0 puts the first band right under the header, as opening="flush" does.
SiteLayout.--c-site-layout-skip-radius: The skip link's corners while it shows on focus, in SiteLayout and LibraryLayout (default radius.none, square). Set var(--radius-md) to follow the controls' corners.

Footer.--c-footer-links-column-min: A two-column section (FooterSection.columns = 2): the narrowest a column of links gets before the section falls back to one column (default 8em). Short labels such as years can take less.

TextField.--c-applied-fill: An applied filter's fill on TextField, Select and SegmentedControl (applied); default color.accent-subtle.
TextField.--c-applied-border: An applied filter's outline on the same controls; default color.accent.

AppLayout.--c-app-layout-header-divider-width: A rule under the header (default 0px, none). Set var(--border-hairline) for an app whose bar is ruled off from the sidebar and the view.

StickyBar.--c-sticky-bar-padding-block: Above and below the bar's controls, at rest and stuck alike (default space.stack-item).

List.--c-list-tile-min: An action list's tiles (layout tiles): the narrowest a tile gets before fewer fit across (default size.column-min). A catalogue in a narrow panel sets a smaller length.
List.--c-list-tile-fill: A tile's surface inside its hairline outline (default color.bg-control). A theme that draws tiles outlined on the page sets var(--color-bg); the outline stays the tile's boundary.
List.--c-list-tile-name-weight: A tile's name (default type.label.weight). A catalogue whose names lead its tiles sets var(--weight-bold) or var(--weight-semibold).

ScreenPreview.--c-screen-preview-desktop: The least width a screen is laid out at with width desktop, scaled down to fit a narrower window (default 80rem, 1280 px). A canvas that shows small text sets a narrower desktop (64rem) for a larger scale.

Section.--c-section-gap: Between a section's head (heading and intro) and its content (default space.stack-section). A theme whose page gap is close to it sets the group gap here, so a heading stays visibly with its content.
Section.--c-section-content-gap: Between the parts of a section's content (default space.stack-group).

Grid.--c-grid-aside: The start column's width when ratio is aside, a heading beside its content (default size.column-min, 16rem).

Link.--link-decoration: A link's line at rest: underline (default) or none. With none, the link colour must stand 3:1 from the text around it; the line still shows on hover and keyboard focus.
Link.--link-decoration-hover: A link's line on hover and keyboard focus: underline (default). Keep it when the rest line is off: it is the cue that isn't colour.

Heading.--type-display-size: The display step's size: Hero and page titles, Heading size="display" and Statistic's large value (default text.xxxxl, 3.5rem). A token (var(--text-…)) or a length.
Heading.--type-display-weight: The display step's weight (default weight.bold). Set 400 for a display face that has one weight, so the browser doesn't fake bold.
Heading.--type-display-leading: The display step's line height (default leading.display). A unitless number or a token.
Heading.--type-display-tracking: The display step's letter spacing (default tracking.display). A length in em or a token.
Heading.--type-jumbo-size: The jumbo step's size: Heading size="jumbo" (default text.jumbo, 5rem). Keep it larger than display; settingsCss and applySettings refuse a jumbo smaller than display when both are lengths.
Heading.--type-jumbo-leading: The jumbo step's line height (default leading.display).
Heading.--type-jumbo-tracking: The jumbo step's letter spacing (default tracking.display).
